preconditions.description: The length of the Ahmes arithmetic expression is between 1 and 10^4.
The number of plus and minus operators are between 0 and 100.

preconditions.expression: P + M = the number of erased operators in E
preconditions.description: The sum of the number of plus and minus operators equals the number of erased operators in the expression.

postconditions.expression: output = max(evaluate(E, ops) for ops in permutations(P * '+' + M * '-', len(E) - 1))
postconditions.description: The output is the maximum possible value of the expression after inserting the plus and minus operators.
